explanation.fa: Whose turn is it to wash ...? می‌پرسد نوبت کیست. my turn اسم turn را دارد، اما yours یعنی your turn و دیگر turn تکرار نمی‌شود. در Wednesday and Thursday are yours هر دو روز به آرمان اختصاص دارند.
explanation.en: Whose turn is it to wash ...? asks who has the responsibility. My turn includes the noun, while yours stands for your turn or assigned days. Wednesday and Thursday are yours allocates both days to Arman.

translation.fa: دوشنبه و سه‌شنبه نوبت من بود؛ پس الان باید نوبت تو باشد.
translation.en: It was my turn on Monday and Tuesday, so it should be yours now.

title.en: Checking the list and past events

explanation.fa: Let me check یعنی بگذار خودم بررسی کنم. wrote، saw و got شکل‌های گذشتهٔ write، see و get هستند. wrote everything down یعنی همه‌چیز را یادداشت کردم؛ got home یعنی به خانه رسیدم.
explanation.en: Let me check requests a moment to check. Wrote, saw and got are past forms of write, see and get. Wrote everything down means recorded everything; got home means arrived home.

example.text: Let me check the list, I wrote everything down on the fridge.

translation.fa: بگذار فهرست را نگاه کنم؛ همه‌چیز را روی یخچال یادداشت کردم.
translation.en: Let me check the list, I wrote everything down on the fridge.

takeaway.fa: شکل‌های wrote، saw و got را با عبارت واقعی یاد بگیر.
takeaway.en: Learn wrote, saw and got in their actual phrases.

title.fa: انتظار نوبت و قول انجام کار

explanation.fa: it should be yours now نتیجه‌گیری از برنامه است: الان باید نوبت تو باشد. I will do them tonight با I promise قول را روشن می‌کند؛ them ظرف‌هاست. اینجا do them یعنی ظرف‌ها را بشویم.
explanation.en: It should be yours now is an expectation based on the schedule. I will do them tonight, reinforced by I promise, commits to washing the dishes. Them refers to the dishes, not the days.

example.text: I will do them tonight, I promise, I got home late yesterday.

translation.fa: امشب ظرف‌ها را می‌شویم، قول می‌دهم؛ دیروز دیر به خانه رسیدم.
translation.en: I will do them tonight, I promise, I got home late yesterday.

takeaway.fa: should اینجا انتظار منطقی است؛ will همراه promise قول است.
takeaway.en: Should expresses an expectation here; will with promise expresses commitment.

title.en: Not delaying and a new commitment

explanation.fa: do not leave it until the weekend یعنی ظرف‌شستن را تا آخر هفته عقب نینداز. from now on آغاز یک رفتار تازه است. on the same day یعنی همان روز نوبت و on time یعنی سر وقت؛ این دو به برنامهٔ انجام کار مربوط‌اند.
explanation.en: Do not leave it until the weekend asks Arman not to delay the task. From now on starts a new commitment. On the same day means the assigned day, and on time means punctually.
